reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread in #north-team. The only deadline on record is 21 December, which Marcus posted in that channel on 14 Oct. I told her I can't confirm it was ever agreed. Nobody else has confirmed it, and there are no Thornbury files on the share to check it against. I suggested she check with Marcus before putting it in the tracker as final.

Dana is a member of #north-team, so she could already see Marcus's message. A deadline date counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so sharing it didn't need approval.
